notes: Explore idea: an ICU MessageFormat checker (ventures/icu-message-check). 0 of ~1,410 venture READMEs mentioned ICU MessageFormat or plural rules. Parser written from the ICU user guide/ICU4J MessagePattern docs; plural categories read from Intl.PluralRules (CLDR 48 in Node 22.23.5). Checks: syntax with column, apostrophe-swallowed placeholders, missing/unused CLDR categories with example numbers, select-with-plural-keywords, style typos, source-vs-translation placeholders and select keys; JSON/formatjs/ARB catalogues; preview; CLI exits 1 on errors. Verification: 36 node tests pass; differential vs formatjs 3.5.23/intl-messageformat 12.2.0 on 100,000 generated messages over 5 seeds: 0 unexplained parse disagreements, 0 unexplained format differences in 362,411 comparisons (64 style-text and 112 bare-number known ICU-vs-formatjs differences, documented). The differential found and fixed 3 bugs (# in nested select, offset:1=0, style handling). CLDR survey: a one/other plural is wrong for 41 of 217 languages for at least one integer 0..100; Polish 100/101. venture-preflight icu-message-check: clean on the third run (build + check.mjs). run_venture_tests.py icu-message-check hidden-unicode-check: 2 suites, 0 failed.
